title: 공군방공관제사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:29321:20181204:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on Operations Commands) <Presidential Decree No. 29321, December 4, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2019.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) through (3) Omitted.

(4) The Decree on the Air Force Air Defense Control Command shall be partially amended as follows:

The heading "(Maintenance of Military Conduct)" of Article 5 shall be replaced with "(Maintenance of Military Discipline)", and the expression "군 풍기(風紀)" (military conduct) in the text of that Article, excluding its heading, shall be replaced with "군기(軍紀)" (military discipline).

(5) through (16) Omitted.

Article 4
Omitted.
